sql: SELECT task_id FROM maintenance_tasks WHERE kind=?1 AND subject_type=?2 AND subject_id=?3 AND workflow_id=?4 AND policy_fingerprint=?5 AND state<>'superseded' AND json_type(evidence_json,'$.external_refresh')='object' ORDER BY created_epoch DESC,task_id LIMIT 1
